text: What does the Curry-Howard correspondence say about the Σ type Σ(x:A).B(x)?
choices: It corresponds to universal quantification ∀x:A. B(x)
It corresponds to existential quantification ∃x:A. B(x)
It corresponds to implication A → B
It corresponds to conjunction A ∧ B
explanation: Σ types are dependent pairs: (a, b) where a:A and b:B(a). This is the computational witness for ∃x:A.B(x).
